name: Syringomyelia
definition: Fluid-filled cavity within the spinal cord that can disrupt sensory and motor pathways, often associated with Chiari malformation, trauma, tumour or arachnoid pathology.

typical: Spasticity or gait symptoms in larger lesions

investigations.principle: MRI is essential for diagnosis and cause assessment.
investigations.MRI: MRI of the spinal cord and craniocervical junction is the key study.

amber: Surgery is selected according to cause, progression and associated Chiari/tumour/CSF-flow abnormality.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neurological phenotype may be documented only as a parallel assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fluid-filled cavity within the spinal cord that can disrupt sensory and motor pathways, often associated with Chiari malformation, trauma, tumour or arachnoid pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
